verdict.rationale: Embedded white-label payroll is a fair axis for a payroll service, but the evidence does not show it. API Central (adp-run-docs-33 to 40) is documented as a data-integration API for automating HR processes and replacing file imports and exports. That is an adjacent capability, not a partner API for embedding or reselling ADP payroll under another brand. The community thread mentions Zenefits building on top of ADP, but it describes ADP cutting off that access, not a documented white-label program.
